skill.name: financial-insights
skill.description:
Reads a user's Link financial data — transactions, balances, and wallet sources — so agents can answer questions about spending and available source capabilities. Use when the user says "check my balance", "how much did I spend", "show my transactions", "what accounts are connected", "summarize my spending", "recent purchases", or asks about their financial activity, account balances, or linked sources.
Also use available precomputed insights to answer questions about shopping preferences or identifying preferred businesses.
skill.summary: Summarize authorized Link transactions, balances, connected accounts, and available shopping insights through the Link CLI.
skill.author: stripe

security_audit.summary: All 93 static detections are false positives involving Markdown backticks, a homepage URL, and financial-data guidance rather than shell substitution or system reconnaissance. Semantic review identified unpinned package permissions and unbounded reliance on response instructions. No evidence found of intentional data exfiltration or an embedded prompt injection attack.

remediation.issue: Tool permissions allow unpinned package execution and global installation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version and require explicit approval before package execution or installation. Prefer an existing verified installation over automatic downloads.

remediation.issue: Authentication guidance directs agents to follow response instructions without an explicit trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Treat response text as data. Allow only documented authentication steps, validate verification URLs, and reject instructions outside the requested authorization flow.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Package Execution and Installation Permissions
semantic_findings.description: The allowed tools include "npx --yes @stripe/link-cli:*" and "npm install -g @stripe/link-cli:*" without a fixed package version. These permissions allow downloaded code execution or global installation without a skill-level confirmation requirement. A compromised future package release could execute code with the agent's host permissions.

content.user_title: Analyze Link Spending, Balances, and Shopping Insights
content.value_statement: Financial questions require selecting relevant records and interpreting amounts, permissions, and data freshness. This skill guides agents through authorized Link queries and clear financial summaries.
actual_capabilities: Guide Link authentication and permission upgrades using the source actions needed for the requested financial data.
Retrieve and summarize transactions filtered by date, category, origin, or connected source.
Interpret current balances, available cash, credit usage, currencies, and update timestamps.
List connected sources, connection status, data capabilities, and user-granted actions.
Discover and retrieve available purchase-pattern insights while distinguishing ready, pending, and unavailable results.
Handle paginated results and format monetary amounts using currency-specific minor units.
limitations: Requires a separately installed Link CLI, network access, and an authenticated session with sufficient permissions.
Only covers financial data available through authorized Link sources; records and balances may be incomplete or stale.
Does not move money, initiate payments, modify financial sources, or provide payment credentials.
Shopping insights describe observed history, not guaranteed preferences; currency conversion requires available exchange-rate data.

use_cases.title: Review Monthly Spending
use_cases.description: Summarize spending for a selected month and category, with transaction counts and clear coverage limits.

use_cases.title: Check Connected Account Funds
use_cases.description: Compare current balances and available funds by account while preserving currencies and reporting update times.

use_cases.title: Inform Merchant Selection
use_cases.description: Use an available purchase-pattern insight to identify frequently used brands without treating past purchases as a purchase authorization.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Balance
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current balance for my connected checking account. Include the currency and last update time.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Category Spending
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize my restaurant spending from [start date] to [end date]. Include transaction count, total spending, and any incomplete coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: analyze a bounded transaction window.

prompt_templates.title: Review Cash and Recent Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare current balances and available cash across my connected accounts. Summarize spending during [date range] by currency. Request only necessary permissions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: combine balances, transactions, and necessary source details.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Available Shopping Insights
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover available shopping insights and retrieve only those relevant to preferred brands. Report timestamps, missing permissions, and uncertainty. Do not initiate purchases.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: select insights and handle authorization or data availability limits.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize July restaurant spending from 12 retrieved transactions totaling USD 342.18.
output_examples.output: You spent USD 342.18 across 12 restaurant transactions in July. This total covers the retrieved transactions from your connected Link sources.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: explain a checking balance of USD 1,523.40 and available cash of USD 1,400.00, updated yesterday.
output_examples.output: Your current checking balance is USD 1,523.40. Available cash is USD 1,400.00. The balance was last updated yesterday and may be stale.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: identify preferred brands when the relevant shopping insight is pending.
output_examples.output: The shopping insight is still pending. No brand preference can be concluded from this result. Check again later.

best_practices: Specify the accounts, date range, and financial question before retrieval to limit data access.
Use a reviewed CLI version, approve requested access, and keep credentials and payment details out of summaries.
Check pagination, currencies, transaction signs, and update times before presenting totals or available funds.
anti_patterns: Retrieve every connected account and data type when a narrower query answers the question.
Combine different currencies or interpret current balances as guaranteed available funds.
Treat purchase history as a definitive preference or authorization to spend money.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need the Link CLI, network access, and an authenticated Link session. Financial retrieval requires the source actions approved by the user.

faq.question: Can it send money or make purchases?
faq.answer: No. Its financial queries are read-only. Payment requests belong to a separate workflow and require separate authorization.

faq.question: Which accounts and transactions can it access?
faq.answer: It accesses only data available through authorized Link sources. Coverage depends on connected accounts, source capabilities, and granted permissions.

faq.question: Are balances guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. Balance timestamps may be hours or days old. Current balances and available cash have different meanings and should be reported separately.

faq.question: How does it handle missing permissions?
faq.answer: It requests only missing access and waits for user approval. For environment-managed tokens, it explains the missing access without attempting a CLI upgrade.

faq.question: Do shopping insights prove my preferences?
faq.answer: No. They summarize observed purchase history. Insights may be pending or unavailable, and their timestamps and uncertainty should be included.
